tracks.label: Bridge & Solutions
tracks.blurb: Roles that pay for the operational judgement you already have, with the AI tooling attached.

why.gap_bridging_angle: Two years reconciling driver manifests against invoices at a logistics firm is the reconciliation half of this role already done, in a domain with the same tolerance for being wrong. The SQL is learnable in the window this posting allows; the habit of not trusting an extract is not.
risk_factors: Fully onsite five days, stated in the posting.
Utility hiring cycles are slow; expect months, not weeks.
